Application.title: Application
Application.description: Student job application for FiLi Middle School Program with resume metadata and AI placement status

id.description: Unique identifier for the application record

studentEmail.description: Student school or verified Google email address

studentAvatar.description: Student avatar image URL or data URI

studentClass.description: Middle school grade level (Grade 6, Grade 7, Grade 8)

jobId.description: Identifier of the middle school position applied for

submissionTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 string representation of submission time

submissionTimestampMs.description: Millisecond precision timestamp for FCFS queue resolution

resumeFileName.description: Original file name of the candidate PDF resume

resumeFileSize.description: File size in bytes of the uploaded PDF

resumeValidity.description: Result of programmatic PDF parser verification

hasCertificates.description: Whether the applicant provided certified skills/awards for preemption priority

aiReasoning.description: Summary explanation of automated qualification screening

aiAnalysis.description: Detailed multi-factor analysis of student resume credentials

displacedCandidateName.description: Name of displaced candidate if certificate preemption occurred

displacedByCandidateName.description: Name of certified candidate who triggered displacement

SlotSettings.title: SlotSettings
SlotSettings.description: Global and individual job position intake configuration

globalSlotsOpen.description: Global master switch for application intake

closedJobIds.description: List of job IDs whose intake is administratively closed

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of last setting change

updatedBy.description: Admin identity who modified slot settings

skilledReservationPercent.description: Percentage of job capacity reserved for skilled/certified applicants (default 25%)

jobSkilledReservationPercents.description: Custom per-job skilled quota percentage overrides

jobMinSkillScores.description: Custom per-job minimum skill scores required for skilled reservation qualification

jobSkilledRequirements.description: Custom per-job certificate focus or specialized requirements for skilled candidate status

skilledReservationScope.description: Whether skilled reservation applies to skilled roles only or all campus jobs

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Authorized administrator record for role-based access control

/applications/{applicationId}.description: Collection of student job applications and placement evaluation records

/slotSettings/global.description: Singleton configuration document controlling application intake for all 19 positions

/admins/{adminId}.description: Collection of authorized school administrators with elevated permissions
